pilot_scope: Same holdout tasks; 29 fully reviewed non-UI categories; one unblinded trial per host/condition. Prior trial guides, not a fresh evaluation of the current release.
limitations: Manual unblinded review; one task per category and no repeated trials.
Copilot Auto is not a fixed model; library-wide batches can share context.
No no-skill control; no causal or publisher-wide superiority conclusion.
Web frontend holdout browser checks remain unmeasured.
Adaptive follow-ups and withdrawn development quality scores are excluded from the comparison.
